title: Velvety Plum Jam Bars
description: A sweet and tangy dessert perfect for kids and adults alike, featuring a velvety plum jam filling and a crumbly oat and brown sugar crust.
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Line an 8-inch square baking dish with parchment paper.

In a medium bowl, whisk together the flour, brown sugar, and salt. Add the cold butter and use a pastry blender or your fingers to work it into the dry ingredients until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
Press the mixture evenly into the prepared baking dish.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the plum jam, eggs, and granulated sugar.
Pour the jam mixture over the crust.
Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until the filling is set and the crust is golden brown.
Let cool completely in the pan before cutting into bars.
Serve warm or at room temperature.
